text:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy release-97a3 to prod (change window: 19:00-21:00 UTC). Kicking off migration batch (5 jobs, parallel=3). Tag: v3.4.1. Commits: 97a3..97af.

deploy-bot: migration 12341 add_user_flags STARTED on worker-1.

ara: watching logs, will ping if index build looks noisy.

sam: @dbops quick q — we running the big user_idx concurrently? last time it bumped locks.

dbops: Recommend pausing the noncritical index build. If we need it, run `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` in follow-up window. Also suggest `SET maintenance_work_mem = '256MB'` before heavy DDLs.

jordan: can we pin this release commit until migrations finish? I don't want a rolling change to pick up new commits mid-run.

deploy-bot: pin applied: service pin -> commit 97a3.

deploy-bot: migration 12345 build_user_idx QUEUED on worker-4. Observed lock wait >30s, pausing that job automatically.

ara: :thumbsup: good call. leave it paused, continue with schema-safe steps.

sam: proceeding with remaining migrations. skipping 12345 for now via `deployctl set-migrations --skip 12345`.

deploy-bot: migration 12342 collapse_flags COMPLETED (worker-2).

deploy-bot: migration 12343 add_nullable_col FAILED, reason: FK constraint violation on staging cleanup step. Rolling back 12343.

dbops: I'll take that. Looks like there's unexpected orphan rows; running quick audit script now:```sql
-- run: find orphaned rows
SELECT id FROM users WHERE account_id IS NULL LIMIT 10;
```

jordan: we should remove 12343 from this release to avoid cascading retries. I unpinned the migration set and re-pinned the service to exclude 12343.

deploy-bot: service pin updated. Active migrations now: 12341, 12342, 12344 (12343 was rolled back and excluded).

oncall-bot: Notifying on-call rotation: @oncall for prod deploy status. :spiral_calendar:

deploy-bot: migration 12344 backfill_flags COMPLETED (worker-3).

deploy-bot: deploy finished with PARTIAL_SUCCESS. Applied 3/4 intended migrations, 1 failed & rolled back (12343), 1 paused (12345). No consumer downtime observed.

deploy-bot: opened follow-up ticket RDW-3145 for 12343 (data cleanup + re-run). ETA for patch release: next maintenance window. Link: https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-3145

ara: adding note to release notes: "Partial migration applied — `add_nullable_col` rolled back due to FK violations. Index `build_user_idx` deferred to follow-up window."

sam: ack. schedule follow-up for concurrent index and data cleanup.

jordan: leaving service pinned to commit 97a3 until RDW-3145 resolved. Will unpin after verification.

dbops: I'll run the audit and propose a safe script, target to re-run in next off-peak window.

deploy-bot: Change window ends 21:00 UTC. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
